purpose: Paired pre-run token-savings benchmark; same originals and questions, new database for every variant.
limitations: No 20–30 minute quiet or 10-minute busy real recording is available. Do not extrapolate observed savings to a day.
Public source questions have been used for prior model debugging; they are fixed but not newly held out.
Object recall is a frozen synonym-string proxy, separately reported from factual question grading.
Do not call model self-confidence, citation resolution, or review agreement ground-truth accuracy.

criteria_origin.note: Existing prewritten source-review criteria; human authorship not independently verified.

questions.question: What food was being assembled on the counter?
questions.criterion: Describes open breakfast sandwiches/bread halves with yellow cheese slices. Cites visible frame evidence; does not invent eggs or other ingredients not shown on the bread.

questions.question: Where was the squeeze bottle put after it was used?
questions.criterion: Places the pale bottle horizontally on the upper stainless shelf above the work area, to the right, with frame evidence. Does not say it stayed there after the excerpt.

questions.question: What color were the squeeze bottle's cap and the slices placed on the bread?
questions.criterion: Red cap and yellow slices, backed by visible frame evidence.

questions.question: Was the squeeze bottle used before or after the yellow slices were placed on the bread?
questions.criterion: Says bottle use came before placing yellow cheese slices; cites frames whose offsets support the ordering. An uncertainty warning is acceptable; reversed order is not.

questions.question: Where did the person put their keys?
questions.criterion: States the excerpt does not establish this; no invented location.

questions.question: What time did the person's work shift begin?
questions.criterion: States the shift start is not established; never substitutes synthetic import time or clip time.

clips.keyframe_annotation: Agent visual annotation before token benchmark; not independent human labels.

criteria_origin.note: Existing prewritten source-review criteria; human authorship not independently verified.

questions.question: What are the people doing in this recording?
questions.criterion: Says people are walking outdoors along/across a paved road or path, with a frame citation.

questions.question: What object is standing on three legs on the grass in the foreground?
questions.criterion: Identifies the tripod and cites a frame; does not invent the make of the camera.

questions.question: What color is the van parked near the building?
questions.criterion: Says white and cites a frame.

questions.question: What did the people say to each other?
questions.criterion: States speech cannot be established from these recordings; does not invent dialogue.

questions.question: What time did these people leave home?
questions.criterion: States departure time is not established; does not use the synthetic import time.

clips.keyframe_annotation: Agent visual annotation before token benchmark; not independent human labels.

clips.construction: 640x480 fixed gray background, brown rectangle, blue circle. A 32x32 red square appears at t=10, moves right at t=20, disappears at t=30. Not a real quiet room.
clips.keyframe_annotation: Deterministic generator specification, not human labels.

questions.question: What color was the small square that appeared?
questions.criterion: Red, supported by an original frame between offsets 10 and 29 seconds.

questions.question: Which direction did the small red square move?
questions.criterion: To the right; supports ordering with frames from 10–19 and 20–29 seconds.

questions.question: Was the red square visible at the end of the recording?
questions.criterion: No, the final sampled frames from 30–39 seconds lack it. Do not generalize beyond the recording.

questions.question: Who owns the blue circle?
questions.criterion: Ownership cannot be established from the recording.

grading.requirement: Explicit post-run source review against frozen criteria; leave unknowns null. Label agent grading as agent grading.
